name: mail
title: Mail
description: Transactional email for Cirrus — a sendEmail action (plus a fire-and-forget queueEmail) built on @cirrus/mail's Resend transport, with CR/LF + header-injection-safe address handling.
docs: Set RESEND_API_KEY (wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY) and MAIL_FROM in your env/.dev.vars, then re-export from cirrus/index.ts so codegen emits api.mail.sendEmail. Drop React email templates next to cirrus/mail/index.ts and pass them via the `react` option. queueEmail needs a Cloudflare Queue binding — see the README before enabling it.

envVars.name: RESEND_API_KEY
envVars.description: Resend API key for the default mail transport. Create one at https://resend.com/api-keys.

envVars.name: MAIL_FROM
envVars.description: Default sender address. Use a verified Resend domain; `Name <addr@host>` or bare `addr@host`.
